absent: Locking discipline for cache topology, alignment fixup, errata matching and restart.
Full layouts of sleep_stack_data, arm_smccc structures, sdei events, ptrauth keys, kimage and ftrace_ops beyond named offsets.
Behavior of MMU disable workaround and hypervisor restart protocol beyond trap invocation.
Firmware cache discovery details and coherency maximum update path.
Complete Thumb and ARM emulation coverage beyond double and multi register forms.
Ordering and concurrency rules for target implementation list publication.
Values and effects of permission encodings PIE_E0 and PIE_E1.
Exact system control bit semantics beyond trapping user accesses.

findings.text: A limit named MAX_CACHE_LEVEL denotes seven as the highest cache level examined.
A routine named cache_line_size returns a global coherency maximum when that global is nonzero and otherwise delegates to a per CPU query.
The routines early_cache_level with init_cache_level with populate_cache_leaves initialize per CPU cache topology for a CPU identifier using detection plus leaf filling.
Cache levels are probed upward from one until a level reports no cache or the maximum is passed. Separate caches contribute two leaves while unified caches contribute one.
A leaf descriptor records a numeric level with a cache kind. Per CPU state records a count of levels with a count of leaves with a list of leaf descriptors.

During full initialization the hardware level is compared with a firmware level from device tree or ACPI. When hardware is lower the level is raised to firmware and the leaf count grows by the difference treating extra levels as unified.

The routine do_compat_alignment_fixup fetches the faulting instruction for the current program counter and emulates only multi register and double word transfers handling both Thumb and ARM encodings.
Alignment emulation reports one of four outcomes called error fault load store needing finalization or fully done. Only the latter two advance past the instruction and count an alignment event.

Double word emulation moves two consecutive 32 bit units between memory and a pair of registers. It rejects odd first registers with certain encodings and distinguishes load versus store by encoding bits.

Multiple register emulation counts set bits in a register mask to size the transfer. It orders the address by direction with preindex flags and moves each selected register in increasing order with special program counter behavior and conditional base writeback.

Sixteen bit Thumb instructions are translated to ARM equivalents for stack with block operations and otherwise rejected with a sentinel. Thirty two bit Thumb detection uses top bits of the first halfword.
A helper named CODING_BITS isolates bits 25 through 27 using mask 0x0e000000 to choose between extension with block handling.

Load store attributes are tested at bit positions 24 for preindex and 23 for direction and 21 for writeback and 20 for load and 22 for halfword immediate form. Equality of preindex with direction is derived from bit 23 after an exclusive combination.

Register selectors use bits 16 to 19 for the base with bits 12 to 15 for the destination with low four bits for an offset register with low sixteen bits for a register mask. The mask for the latter is 0xffff.
An illegal encoding sentinel has value 0xdeadc0de. Alignment outcomes are numbered zero for error with one for fault with two for load store needing finalization with three for done.
Thumb2 32 bit detection checks that top three bits of the first halfword are set and that either of the next two bits is set using masks 0xe000 with 0x1800.
An offset carrier is a union offering the same storage as either unsigned or signed. It is used to apply direction before address adjustment with conditional base update.

A low level restart entry named cpu_soft_restart disables translation through the system control register with a barrier. It then either requests hypervisor restart or branches to a supplied entry with three arguments.

A setter records a caller supplied array of processor identifiers for errata matching exactly once. It rejects empty or repeated configuration after which matching consults that array instead of the current processor.
Affected range testing first checks model with version bounds and then exempts revisions whose masked revision identifier indicates a fix. List testing scans entries until a terminator.
Direct processor identifier reads for errata decisions require local CPU scope with a non preemptible context. Otherwise a warning is raised.
Cache type consistency compares both raw with effective cache type values masked to strict bits against the system value. Mismatch on both indicates an incompatible secondary.

A disabled by default static key enables a cache handling fix via an early boot parameter. Capability checks consult that key and enablement clears specific user trap bits to force trapping on mismatch or erratum.

One Cortex workaround requires both a list match with execution in hypervisor mode. A ThunderX2 virtualization workaround requires a family match plus hypervisor availability plus a nonzero low affinity on some possible processor.

Assembly constants MPIDR_HASH_MASK with MPIDR_HASH_SHIFTS expose positions of mask with shift components of affinity hash bookkeeping. SLEEP_STACK_DATA_SYSTEM_REGS with SLEEP_STACK_DATA_CALLEE_REGS expose positions of system with callee portions of suspend stack bookkeeping.

Result offsets ARM_SMCCC_RES_X0_OFFS with ARM_SMCCC_RES_X2_OFFS with quirk offsets ARM_SMCCC_QUIRK_ID_OFFS with ARM_SMCCC_QUIRK_STATE_OFFS expose selected result slots with quirk identity plus state for secure call handling.

Nine constants for secure call version 1.2 expose even register slots from zero to sixteen. Coverage runs from ARM_SMCCC_1_2_REGS_X0_OFFS through ARM_SMCCC_1_2_REGS_X16_OFFS with each naming the position of the corresponding argument slot.

Hibernate chain offsets HIBERN_PBE_ORIG with HIBERN_PBE_ADDR with HIBERN_PBE_NEXT expose original address plus address plus link of page backup entries. ARM64_FTR_SYSVAL exposes the system value within feature register state.

Optional assembly values include TRAMP_VALIAS for trampoline mapping with SDEI_EVENT_INTREGS plus SDEI_EVENT_PRIORITY for event interrupted state with priority. Pointer authentication positions PTRAUTH_USER_KEY_APIA with PTRAUTH_KERNEL_KEY_APIA are also exposed.

For crash loading constants KIMAGE_HEAD with KIMAGE_START expose list linkage with entry. Constants KIMAGE_ARCH_TTBR1 with KIMAGE_ARCH_PHYS_OFFSET with KIMAGE_ARCH_ZERO_PAGE with KIMAGE_ARCH_EL2_VECTORS with KIMAGE_ARCH_DTB_MEM expose translation base plus physical offset plus zero page plus hypervisor vectors plus device tree memory. Tracing uses FTRACE_OPS_FUNC with FTRACE_OPS_DIRECT_CALL and permissions use PIE_E0_ASM with PIE_E1_ASM.

Emulation touches user memory with checked accesses that report faults. Instruction fetching may also fault and fault or encoding error aborts without advancing while success advances by two or four bytes.
Several errata predicates warn when invoked outside local scope or in preemptible context. This indicates the caller must disable preemption with target the local processor.
A Kryo identifier test masks implementor plus partial part number plus architecture fields before comparing against an expected model value.

Helper shorthands build capability entries that pair a matcher with either a single model range or all versions of a model or a fixed revision exemption or a list. All such entries are typed as local CPU errata.
A family table named tx2_family_cpus lists MIDR_BRCM_VULCAN with MIDR_CAVIUM_THUNDERX2 for all versions terminated by an empty entry.

Thirty two bit Thumb decoding routes multi register patterns to block emulation with double word patterns to double emulation with an immediate scaled offset. Other patterns lead to rejection and single register push pop is rewritten to block form.
Hibernate bookkeeping forms a linked list where each element carries an original address with a destination address with a link. Feature state carries a system value used for sanitization.

Predicates is_midr_in_range_list with is_affected_midr_range with is_affected_midr_range_list with is_kryo_midr with has_mismatched_cache_type expose errata matching decisions to capability infrastructure.

Enablement routines cpu_enable_trap_ctr_access with cpu_enable_cache_maint_trap with detectors has_cortex_a76_erratum_1463225 with needs_tx2_tvm_workaround with need_arm_si_l1_workaround_4311569 expose workaround control.
